reserveReview.rationale: Quantoz's Reserve Status Overview dated June 30, 2026 (the latest published snapshot as of 2026-08-08) reports USDQ at 30% allocated cash and 70% government bonds, with a 101.23% reserve ratio. The USDQ whitepaper confirms that at least 30% is held in separate bank accounts and the remainder in secure, low-risk, highly liquid instruments; the dashboard identifies the bond issuers as the Netherlands, Germany, and United States. The snapshot is 39 days old as of the review date, so it sits outside the 31-day V9 admission window.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Quantoz Reserve Status Overview updated June 30, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The two disclosed categories cover the full reserve allocation, but Quantoz does not identify individual banking partners, bond security identifiers, country weights, or a maximum maturity. Liquidity horizon therefore remains unknown for the government-bond bucket.
